en.summary: Malawi's FY2026/27 budget of K10.978 trillion (about US$6.8bn), passed on 24 March 2026, gives agriculture the largest share at K971.3bn. With the World Bank projecting 2.3% growth and 21.9% inflation, FX shortages and heavy debt are undermining the budget's assumptions.
watch: World Bank projects 2.3% growth (govt 4.1%) and 21.9% inflation (govt 15%)
Public debt projected at 92.3% of GDP; about half of domestic revenue goes to debt service
FX shortages disrupting fuel and raw-material imports
